TABLE.NAME: vrroom
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per VR room activity.

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: The course this activity is in.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity name.

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity description.

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of the intro field.

FIELD.NAME: runtime
FIELD.COMMENT: Short name of the vrroomruntime sub-plugin that delivers the room.

FIELD.NAME: template
FIELD.COMMENT: Short name of the vrroomtemplate sub-plugin that built the room. Fixed after creation.

FIELD.NAME: templateconfig
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON configuration of the template, so the form can be edited again.

FIELD.NAME: graphjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Current task graph (vrroom-graph/1), a copy of the latest vrroom_graphs row.

FIELD.NAME: graphversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Current graph version (vrroom_graphs.version).

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum grade (points only; 0 = no grade).

FIELD.NAME: grademethod
FIELD.COMMENT: How attempt scores combine: 1 highest, 2 average, 3 last.

FIELD.NAME: maxattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Attempts allowed per user; 0 = unlimited.

FIELD.NAME: questionmode
FIELD.COMMENT: How students answer questions: once = one try per question in an attempt; retry = try again until fully correct.

FIELD.NAME: retrypenalty
FIELD.COMMENT: With questionmode retry: share of a question's points lost for each wrong try before the right answer.

FIELD.NAME: completionobjectives
FIELD.COMMENT: Completion rule: all required objectives completed in a finished attempt.

FIELD.NAME: customised
FIELD.COMMENT: Time of the first room editor save; 0 while the room is built by its template.

FIELD.NAME: livemode
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 off, 1 on with a fixed number of rooms, 2 on with rooms students open; every person keeps their own attempt.

FIELD.NAME: livemaxusers
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum people in one live room, 2 upwards; the run mode caps it at what it supports.

FIELD.NAME: liverooms
FIELD.COMMENT: Live rooms: in fixed mode the number of rooms (1-20); in dynamic mode the most rooms open at once (0 = no limit). In group mode per group.

FIELD.NAME: livevideo
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when people may turn on their webcam in live rooms (built-in run mode, also needs the site setting), 0 when not.

FIELD.NAME: vrroomid
FIELD.COMMENT: The activity.

FIELD.NAME: idnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Scene id (uuid) used in the scene document and in statement IRIs.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Scene name.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Order of the scene; the first is the start scene.

FIELD.NAME: scenejson
FIELD.COMMENT: The scene document as JSON.

FIELD.NAME: schemaversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Schema of scenejson.

TABLE.NAME: vrroom_graphs
TABLE.COMMENT: Every version of an activity's task graph (vrroom-graph/1), so old attempts can be replayed.

FIELD.NAME: vrroomid
FIELD.COMMENT: The activity.

FIELD.NAME: version
FIELD.COMMENT: Graph version, 1 upwards per activity.

FIELD.NAME: graphjson
FIELD.COMMENT: The graph document as JSON.

TABLE.NAME: vrroom_slots
TABLE.COMMENT: Question slots of an activity. question_references.itemid points at these rows.

FIELD.NAME: vrroomid
FIELD.COMMENT: The activity.

FIELD.NAME: slot
FIELD.COMMENT: Slot number used by the graph, 1..n.

FIELD.NAME: objectiveid
FIELD.COMMENT: The answer_question objective this slot belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: maxmark
FIELD.COMMENT: Mark the question is out of.

TABLE.NAME: vrroom_attempts
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per attempt of a user at an activity.

FIELD.NAME: vrroomid
FIELD.COMMENT: The activity.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user making the attempt.

FIELD.NAME: attempt
FIELD.COMMENT: Attempt number per user, 1 upwards.

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: inprogress, finished or abandoned.

FIELD.NAME: uniqueid
FIELD.COMMENT: The question usage of this attempt.

FIELD.NAME: slotmap
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON map from graph slot number to question usage slot number.

FIELD.NAME: graphversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Graph version the attempt is played under.

FIELD.NAME: score
FIELD.COMMENT: Score as a fraction 0..1, recomputed from the events.

FIELD.NAME: requireddone
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when every required objective has been completed.

FIELD.NAME: timedue
FIELD.COMMENT: When the attempt's time runs out (timestart + graph timelimit); 0 = no limit.

TABLE.NAME: vrroom_events
TABLE.COMMENT: Accepted xAPI statements of an attempt, in order of acceptance.

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: The attempt.

FIELD.NAME: statementid
FIELD.COMMENT: Statement id (lowercase uuid); unique, so a resend is ignored.

FIELD.NAME: verb
FIELD.COMMENT: Short verb of the vrroom-vocab/1 vocabulary.

FIELD.NAME: objecttype
FIELD.COMMENT: activity, scene, zone, object, question or objective.

FIELD.NAME: sceneid
FIELD.COMMENT: Scene id, when the object is in a scene.

FIELD.NAME: objectid
FIELD.COMMENT: Object id; null for the activity.

FIELD.NAME: resultjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Result calculated by the server, as JSON.

FIELD.NAME: clientasserted
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the browser reported the statement.

FIELD.NAME: timestamp
FIELD.COMMENT: When the client says it happened (clamped).

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the server recorded it.
